title: Server Sent Events (SSE)
definition: Server-Sent Events (SSE) is a standard allowing a browser to receive automatic updates from a server via HTTP connection. Unlike WebSockets, SSE is unidirectional (Server -> Client only).
simpleExplanation: SSE is like subscribing to a newsletter. You tell the server you want updates, and the server continuously sends you messages without you having to ask again.

answers.question: What is the main bottleneck for Server Sent Events?
